text:
Aisha Khan: starting staged canary deploy r-20260322-508 -> v5.0.0. Regions: ap-northeast 7%, na-west 5%. Change window 23:30-02:30 UTC. Stop/go check? watching: 5xx, 99p latency, auth timeout.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Rollout initiated r-20260322-508. ap-northeast(7%), na-west(5%). Fallback snapshot v4.9.4 created. Scheduled auto-bumps enabled.
Marco Rivera: copying. I'll attach per-route error heatmap and token bucket traces.
Ivy Zhang: initial telemetry: na-west 99p went 1.0s -> 1.6s within 3m, 5xx steady at 0.05%. No auth timeouts yet.
SRE Lead: pause rule: pause if 5xx >0.5% OR 99p >2s sustained for 4m OR auth timeouts >1% for 3m. Standing by.
Aisha Khan: @Deploy Bot pin fallback v4.9.4 and enable manual bump only until we confirm tail stability.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Fallback v4.9.4 pinned. Auto-bumps paused. Notifying oncall and #product.
Marco Rivera: checking logs — seeing intermittent droppped keepalive on one nat-gw in ap-northeast (host apn-12). Might explain spikes.
Ivy Zhang: reproducer run shows occasional auth timeout when concurrency bursts >50 requests/s to apn-12.
Support Lead: flagged support tickets with affected clients; sending short advisory to docs team.
Aisha Khan: decision: hold for 30m while infra cycles the gateway. If auth timeouts persist or 99p >2s for 4m, rollback.
SRE Lead: draining apn-12 now and provisioning replacement. Will report back on memory and socket stats.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Canary paused. Replacement host scheduled apn-repl-07.
Marco Rivera: after drain, socket error rate dropped 80%. Re-run telemetry: 99p back to 1.05s, auth timeouts down to 0.1%.
Ivy Zhang: running canary-smoke eval suite -> 49/50 pass; one failure was a flaky token exchange timeout which matches the gateway blip.
Aisha Khan: OK good. @Deploy Bot schedule a cautious ramp: ap-northeast -> 20% in 15m, na-west -> 15% in 20m if stable. Keep fallback pinned for 1 hour post-rollout.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Scheduled bump to ap-northeast 20% in 15m for r-20260322-508; na-west 15% in 20m. Will respect pause signals.
Support Lead: posting interim note to customers watching latency-sensitive routes.
SRE Lead: continuing 15m watch on sockets and keepalive resets. If any host shows >3% socket errors we hit rollback.
Ivy Zhang: logging alert added: tag requests with canary=true and trace-id for quick triage.
Aisha Khan: thanks all. This thread is the official stop/go log for this rollout. If anything changes call an immediate stop and we'll flip fallback.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Next bump queued. Will not proceed if paused.
